name: dipper-monorepo
description: Monorepo for dipper: the `dipper` server/CLI, the web UI, and the packages they share.
author: Sumit Kumar (https://github.com/SumitKumar-17)

scripts.build: bun run --filter @dipper/web build && bun run --filter dipper build
scripts.start:site: bun --cwd=apps/site run build && bun --cwd=apps/site run preview
scripts.lint: eslint apps/web/src apps/web/vite.config.ts apps/site/src packages/ui/src && bun run --filter dipper lint
scripts.test: bun test packages && bun run --filter dipper test
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/server/dist apps/server/ui apps/server/webui/static apps/web/dist .turbo apps/*/.turbo
